name: Sleep Timer
description: Automatically stop playback after a user-defined duration. Features preset timers (15m-2h), an 'Are you still watching?' popup before stopping, and per-device install/uninstall from the dashboard.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.x compatibility: bumped targetAbi to 12.0.0.0, migrated to .NET 10, updated Jellyfin SDK package references. Fixed repo URL mismatch in manifest sourceUrl and README. Made popup grace period configurable. Added server-side config options (default duration, grace period, enable/disable popup).
Fix sleep timer button disappearing on restart and when switching shows. Persistent MutationObserver with subtree watching, broader middleware path matching, re-sync timer state on OSD rebuild.
Remove custom duration input. Add +5m extend button. Fix middleware bug that caused blank dashboard pages.
Remove pre-stop notification feature. The popup handles the stop decision.
